records.generatedCopy: Chrome DevTools MCP 1.7 gives AI coding agents native heap-object and context analysis, but a large snapshot still is not proof of a leak. This guide turns the release into a three-snapshot, ten-cycle workflow: isolate retained growth, follow one retaining path into application code, replay against a fixed budget, and close every snapshot. Use it when you need reviewable evidence instead of an agent guess.

A huge heap snapshot is evidence, not a diagnosis. Chrome DevTools MCP 1.7 lets an agent compare baseline, target, and cleanup snapshots, isolate native contexts, then follow one retaining chain before editing code.
